The definition of $\operatorname{coth}⁡x$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{coth}⁡x & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{tanh}⁡x} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}+1}{{e}^{2x}-1} \\  & =\frac{1+{e}^{-2x}}{1-{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the third definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{coth}⁡(\operatorname{ln}⁡2) & =\frac{{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡2}+1}{{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡2}-1} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{2}^{2}}+1}{{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{2}^{2}}-1} \\  & =\frac{{2}^{2}+1}{{2}^{2}-1} \\  & =\frac{4+1}{4-1} \\  & =\frac{5}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
